'''Chata Hyoki''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
[[File:WristBlaster-POP.png|thumb|left|200px|Hyoki firing his wrist blaster.]]
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Chata Hyoki, along with [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]], attempted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] for [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. They also injured [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]], and several other senators to try to stop a vote on a [[Republic military enhancement bill/Legends|Senate bill]]. He was arrested along with [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]] when they attacked Bail in a car park.

==Equipment==
He had concealable [[Wrist blaster/Legends|wrist blasters]] on both of his gauntlets, and a [[Liquid-cable launcher/Legends|grappling spike launcher]] on his left gauntlet.
He also made use of a small hand [[Knife/Legends|knife]]. He wore a personalised helmet and [[battle armor]] designed for [[Selkath/Legends|Selkaths]]. Because of him being an aquatic species, his chest armor had mist vents to keep his skin moist.<ref name="Pursuit of Peace Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode311.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Pursuit of Peace}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
His gauntlets appear to be the same, but since he is only seen using the [[Liquid-cable launcher/Legends|grappling spike launcher]] on his left gauntlet, it is presumed he only has one. His [[StarWars.com]] "clone card" incorrectly states he has a dart shooter instead of a [[Liquid-cable launcher/Legends|Grappling spike launcher]], and a wrist-mounted laser, instead of [[Wrist blaster/Legends|Wrist blasters]], as he is seen using in his first appearance.

Chata Hyoki was voiced by [[Corey Burton]] who also voiced Count Dooku and many other characters in the series. The model for Hyoki was later used for [[Morgo/Legends|Morgo]], a character in the episode [[Padawan Lost]].<ref name="pleg">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode321.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Padawan Lost}}</ref>
